import os, subprocess, textwrap, tempfile, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib')
# create a few candidate VCF inputs and run target directly
cands=[
('a.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT\t0/1\n'),
('b.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT:AD\t0/1:1,2\n'),
('c.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT:PL\t0/1:1,2,3\n'),
('d.vcf', b'##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\ts1\n1\t1\t.\tA\tC\t.\t.\t.\tGT:AD:PL\t0/1:1,2:1,2,3\n'),
]
for name,data in cands:
    path='/tmp/'+name
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['./hts_open_fuzzer',path],cwd=p,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    print(name,r.returncode,len(r.stdout),r.stdout[:200])
